text:
rewards table (d6)
1 Recover 1 Life and 1 Sanity. Gain 1 XP.
2 Recover 2 Life or gain 2 XP, your choice.
3 Recover 2 Life and 1 Sanity or gain 1 XP, your choice.
4
Gain 2 Food, and in addition recover 1 Sanity or gain 2 XP, your
choice, or gain two random items from the Random Items table
and/or the Useful Stuff table, your choice.
5
Gain d6 Food, recover 1 Sanity and 1  Life. If you are already
carrying the maximum Food allowed and your Sanity and Life are
at their full value, you may choose to gain 2 XP instead.
6 Heal all Life and Sanity up to your starting values or gain 1 XP, your
choice.

zh-CN.title: 奖励表（D6）
text:
1 恢复1点生命和1点理智，获得1点经验。
2 恢复2点生命，或获得2点经验，由你选择。
3 恢复2点生命和1点理智，或获得1点经验，由你选择。

4
获得2点食物，此外恢复1点理智或获得2点经验（二选一）；或者从随机物品表和/或有用物品表中获得2件随机物品，由你选择。

5
获得D6点食物，恢复1点理智和1点生命。若携带食物已达上限，且理智与生命均已满值，则可改为获得2点经验。
6 将生命和理智恢复至初始值，或获得1点经验，由你选择。
